# Csv thread analysis

**Source:** csv - uploaded file
**Analysis reference:** A-10ecee17
**Records collected:** 686274 -> **657367** after cleaning/dedup (4.2% removed)
**Model quality:** not reported without an independently labelled evaluation set.
**Privacy mode:** redacted (Stored text has emails, phone numbers, usernames and links replaced with placeholders.)

## Sentiment breakdown
- Positive: 43.1%
- Neutral: 28.7%
- Negative: 28.2%

Average VADER compound score: -0.124 | Average TextBlob polarity: 0.0

## Top discussion topics
israel, hamas, people, their, what, there, from, them, about, would

## Methodology
Every de-duplicated record was scored with SenticNet 9 (concept-level lookup with
multi-word concepts, polarity and the four Hourglass dimensions). Records where fewer
than 50% of the content words were found in SenticNet fall back to VADER and are
flagged as such. VADER and TextBlob were also run on every record as baselines so scores
can be cross-checked. Each record's explanation lists the SenticNet concepts behind its score.
